title: Rosalind and the Vow
author: Coral Yarrow
blurb: Astrid Dravenmoor, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
